parts.text: The law of constant composition states that all pure samples of a compound contain the same elements in the same proportion by weight. A typical experiment to test this law is to prepare the same compound by different methods and then show that the samples have the same composition. Methods of making copper( II ) oxide include: • heating copper carbonate, • heating copper hydroxide, • heating copper nitrate, • heating copper foil in air.
